description:
This flavour has been on my list for so long, since it left the shelves in 2010, I wanted to make it. 

We know the name might bring certain thoughts forward but....this is just an ice cream and Ben & Jerry's Fossil Fuel was one hell of a flavour!
We promise, not a single fossile fuel was disturbed during the making of this video ;) (not by us anyway.....maybe)

Did you enjoy this flavour when it was available? If not, what was your favourite flavour that's no more?

If you want to make this ice cream, this is what you'll need....

The Ice Cream Base:
750ml Milk
450ml Double Cream (Heavy Cream)
300g Sugar
7.5g Silk Gel OR 45g Skimmed Milk Powder

Fudge Dinosaurs:
We used Milk Chocolate but if you want the chocolate fudgy, add 15-1 water to your chocolate and heat it to melt. Or you can add a 0.5 tsp of Coconut Oil to the chocolate before melting. 

The Fudge Swirl:
125g Dairy Milk Chocolate
125 Butter
1 Egg
30g Sugar
Optional: 5g Glucose

The Cookie Pieces were off the shelf as i'm a rubbish baker but if you have a recipe you like and can actually make them......feel free. 

Combine in any way you fancy and pop it in the freezer for a couple of hours minimum, then open the tub and get your DINO JAWS around this great flavour. 


If you enjoyed this video, please consider liking and subscribing, plus pop over to our Instagram and Facebook pages linked below and say hello :)
